transport: private authenticated Unix socket; separate from status.sock
peer_checks: exact selected signed application and running PID

methods.inspect: Read at most two minimal task rows, capabilities and opaque statusSession/statusTask binding; no task content.
methods.focus: Restore and confirm the selected running host workbench; no execution.
methods.draft: Read or save only the selected task composer draft, using a revision compare-and-swap. An optional receipt ID reads that same task thread's submission state without sending or replaying it.
methods.submit: A user-clicked supplement through the existing TWOS queue or supported turn/steer.
methods.editQueue: Revise only a matching unsent queue item; preserve delivered history.
methods.stop: Revoke the matching future queue/relay before interrupting only its exact execution.

status_channel: Unchanged twos.nyra.status.v4 read-only snapshots; never accepts control requests.
side_effects: inspect/focus/draft-save do not create model turns. submit is explicit user input. stop never rolls back completed effects.
disclosure: The control channel carries text deliberately typed by the user and selected draft text. No approval, shell, file upload, credential, arbitrary recipient or expanded scope capabilities exist.
old_clients: Old status readers remain read-only. Standalone controls require explicit authorization in TWOS; old standalone grants remain status-only.
recovery: No automatic replay on timeout/restart. A request ID is deduplicated for the current host lifetime; uncertain dispatch needs controller reconciliation.

task_capabilities.scope: Opaque stable selected conversation identity; not a path or account
task_capabilities.target: Exact instance, conversation and turn binding; frozen by editor
task_capabilities.canEdit: May open/save this bound draft; does not imply send or execution authority
task_capabilities.canAppend: May submit a supplement to the actual controlled run
task_capabilities.canStop: May request stop for this exact owned activity

receipt_observation.scope: A submission in the exact current bound thread only; not an arbitrary delivery lookup
receipt_observation.retries: Read-only bounded observation while sending; never resubmit an uncertain mutation
receipt_observation.success_semantics: Accepted/running/completed confirms controller receipt progression, not business acceptance.

host_focus.transport: separate authenticated focus.sock; status.sock remains pull-only
host_focus.permissions: Exact signed same-user selected peer; no task target, draft, execution or control grant required. Mutation and extra fields rejected.
host_focus.fallback: Older host without focus endpoint: bounded original control focus with no task target; never claims window success on activate alone.

status_action_binding: Bubble actions require matching host instance and read-only session/task frame; absent older-host metadata never grants a guessed target.
